interpretation: The 2026 full text provides a valid direct LA→AC distance, but it is an anatomic/3-D landmark distance rather than a proven pure mediolateral component.
Therefore it can rule out shoulder solutions whose required transverse AC→lateral-acromion offset exceeds the 3-D distance, but it cannot be subtracted from biacromial breadth as an exact equality.
The 50/60/70 mm SC sweep all remain possible against the reported 23–52 mm 3-D range; the 70 mm case requires the smallest transverse LA→AC component and is therefore less demanding.
Independent manubrial breadth data provide additional scale context but are not direct SC-centre measurements. Exact SC/AC X coordinates are still not frozen.
coordinate_convention_note: The component magnitudes are anatomical. HGPT world signs must be mapped using the established character basis (anatomical left +X, posterior direction verified separately) before writing Blender coordinates.
next_step: Use the evidence-filtered transverse family to solve candidate SC/AC X coordinates, then close AP/superior coordinates from manubrial notch geometry and the scapular local frame. Do not freeze c001 yet.

audit_correction_2026_10_08.issue: The earlier file called the 50/60/70 mm SC sweep a feasible evidence family and compared required transverse AC offsets to an incorrectly transcribed 34±8 mm source.
audit_correction_2026_10_08.correction: The sweep is retained only as transparent geometry exploration. The invalid AC-offset source comparison is removed and no sample solution is freeze-eligible.

full_text_followup.issue: Earlier recheck correctly rejected an inferred 34±8 mm offset obtained by subtracting STSL distances.
full_text_followup.new_evidence: The 2026 full text independently and explicitly reports lateral-acromion→AC distance = 3.4±0.8 cm (range 2.3–5.2 cm).
full_text_followup.consequence: The direct 34±8 mm relation is reinstated as a measured constraint, while the invalid subtraction inference remains rejected.
full_text_followup.semantic_guard: Reinstating the direct 34±8 mm measurement does not reinstate the old equality assumption. The valid relation is transverse_component <= measured_3D_distance.

derived_mean_consistency.semantic_warning: These are conditional lower-bound consistency calculations. The direct LA→AC measurement is not proven to be purely transverse, so no exact AC or SC breadth is selected from subtraction.
derived_mean_consistency.reading: The source now constrains the transverse family without fixing it. Solutions demanding a per-side transverse AC→lateral-acromion offset larger than the measured 3-D distance are impossible; solutions inside the observed 3-D range remain feasible.

source_semantics_review: Length/orientation endpoints are not matched. Existing computed rows are retained diagnostic arithmetic, not an evidence-filtered articular-centre target family.
